_comment: Strict typecheck for the MAIN-process overlay sources.
tsconfig.check.json covers the renderer; nothing covered these, so a type
error in main/planide/*.ts was only ever caught by Orca's own typecheck in
CI -- after a push. Same gap that shipped a release with no installers.
ipc.ts is deliberately absent: it imports electron, whose types ship with
electron itself and are not installed here. Writing a stub for it would
assert signatures we cannot check against the real thing, which is worse
than a documented hole -- Orca's own typecheck in CI covers that file.
